info.description: The document enlists and describes the APIs for the User.
info.title: Glowmarkt User System

post.description: Create a User a directory account for username and password login using this action. More specifically this is a registration process which creates a user and adds an account to the given application id. Self-Registration process should use this action. This call requires no authentication.

parameters.name: addUserBody
parameters.description: The information that is used to create a user.

get.summary: Find specific user that has an account in an application from the username.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username of user that is being queried (lowercase, trimmed etc). Please note that this API is prone to errors if the username contains characters that are affected by URL encoding.

post.description: This call can be used by an application to create a user. No verification will be required

parameters.name: createUserBody
parameters.description: The information that is used to create a user.

get.summary: Find specific user that has an account in an application.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: ID of user that is being queried

delete.summary: Delete specific user. This will delete all the accounts of a user. Please refer to delete account API. This API requires specific permissions.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: ID of user that is being queried

post.description: This call generates a 4 digit token and sends it via second channel of communication over to the user (at the moment the only second channel of communication supported is email).

parameters.name: generateVerificationTokenUserReq
parameters.description: The information that is used to create to generate an email verification token.

put.description: This call generates a 4 digit token and sends it via second channel of communication over to the user (at the moment the only second channel of communication supported is email).

parameters.name: verifyDevUser
parameters.description: The information that is used to create a devuser.

post.summary: Generate a token that can be used by user to reset their password.
post.description: This call generates a 4 digit token and sends it via second channel of communication over to the user (at the moment the only second channel of communication supported is email). The user can then use this token to reset their password.

parameters.name: generatePasswordResetTokenUserReq
parameters.description: The information that is needed to generate a password reset token.

put.description: This call generates a 4 digit token and sends it via second channel of communication over to the user (at the moment the only second channel of communication supported is email).

parameters.name: resetPasswordUserBody
parameters.description: The information that is used to reset a user's password.

get.summary: Find the status of a specified account. If the account is using an external directory service, this call will confirm whether the user is authenticated against it. This call requires administrative application level credentials.

get.summary: With a given JWT token a user can have their account status verfied. If their account is created under an external directory service, this call will establish whether a user's token to the external service is still valid.

get.summary: Checks whether a user token is valid.
get.description: Checks whether a user token is valid.

post.description: Autheticates the user and generates a JWT token.

parameters.name: applicationId
parameters.description: The ID of the application

parameters.name: UsernameLoginDetails
parameters.description: The information that is required to authenticate an account.

get.summary: Returns all the tokens that are active and valid for a specified user.
get.description: This call enables a customer to view all the tokens that have been generated and used for their accounts. This includes all the JWT and OAuth tokens. By enabling this a user can then manage and monitor the access to their accounts.

delete.summary: Deletes a token, specified by its tokenId.
delete.description: This call enables an user to delete and token and revoke access. JWT as well as OAuth tokens can be deleted.

parameters.name: tokenId
parameters.description: GUID of token that is to be deleted

get.summary: Generate a new token for an account.
get.description: An account provides an old token and gets a new one generated.

token.description: A new valid token for an account

delete.description: Delete the token the account used to make this call.

get.summary: Check and validate an Oauth Access token.
get.description: The user system supports an OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Grant. This call validates that a generated access key is valid.

post.summary: Authenticate a user and generate an OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Grant.
post.description: The user system supports an OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Grant. This call authenticates a user and generates an OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Grant.

parameters.name: applicationId
parameters.description: The ID of the application

parameters.name: UsernameLoginDetails
parameters.description: The information that is required to authenticate an account.

post.summary: Exchange the Authorization Code for an Access Token.
post.description: The user system supports an OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Grant. This call generates an access and refresh token from an OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Grant. This API can also be used to generate a new access token with a given refresh token. Instead of using the authorization code in the body of the request (code), use the refresh token (refresh_token).

parameters.name: ExchangeAuthorizationCodeWithAccessBody
parameters.description: The information that is required to authenticate an account.
